spans.claim: Official action text for third reading: O'Connell moved to suspend the rules and offered Amendment No. 2 -- this is the specific sentence LEG-BL2021-971's manifest anchor was written for, and it disagrees with Amendment No. 2's own PDF, which is sponsored by Erin Evans.
